title: Warm Citrusy Japanese Chicken Donburi
description: A date-night Japanese dish perfect for a cozy evening in, featuring a citrusy and savory chicken, melted cheese, and a hint of light rum.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine 1/2 cup freshly squeezed orange juice, 1/4 cup soy sauce, 2 cloves minced garlic, and 1 tsp grated ginger. Blend until smooth.
In a large bowl, whisk together the citrus marinade and 1 tsp sesame oil. Add the chicken strips and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.

Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off. Cook the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the brown rice according to package instructions. Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and set aside.
Once the chicken is cooked, transfer it to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.

In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tbsp sesame oil. Pour in 1 tsp light rum (if using) and ignite the mixture with a match or lighter, carefully holding the flame to the liquid until it burns off.
Add the sliced green onions and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until they are slightly softened.
To assemble the donburi, place a scoop of cooked brown rice on a plate or in a bowl. Top with sliced chicken, melted mozzarella cheese, and a drizzle of sushi vinegar.
